name: astro-payload-medusa
description: A teaching stack: Astro 7 storefront over a Medusa 2 commerce backend and a Payload 3 CMS. Each service implements CRUD + REST in its own idiom so the architectures can be compared side by side.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.dev:cms: mkdir -p logs && npm --prefix apps/cms run dev 2>&1 | tee logs/cms.log
scripts.dev:commerce: mkdir -p logs && npm --prefix apps/commerce run dev 2>&1 | tee logs/commerce.log
scripts.dev:storefront: mkdir -p logs && npm --prefix apps/storefront run dev 2>&1 | tee logs/storefront-launch.log
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/cms install && npm --prefix apps/commerce install && npm --prefix apps/storefront install
scripts.reset:all: npm run db:reset && npm run setup && npm run postman:env
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/storefront run test && npm --prefix apps/commerce run test:compensation
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/cms run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/commerce run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/storefront run typecheck
